text: Yesterday after school, I rushed home to play Roblox with my best friend, Sam. We played a game called Adopt Me where you get cool pets. I got a rare dragon egg and I was so excited! But then my mom said I had to stop and eat dinner. After we ate, I watched a new episode of Pokémon on TV. Pikachu is my favorite because he is really strong and cute. I wish I had a Pikachu in real life. Tomorrow, I am going to try to build a huge castle in Minecraft before bedtime.

I love playing Roblox with my best friend Sam. Last Saturday, we played a game called "Adopt Me" for two whole hours! I got a legendary pet dragon, and Sam was so jealous. He kept shouting, "No way! How did you get that?" Then my mom said we had to stop and eat lunch. I was sad, but after we ate sandwiches, we watched Pokemon on TV. Ash Ketchum is the best trainer ever because he loves Pikachu so much. I wish I had a real Pikachu.

My brother Leo thinks he’s so tough, but he’s actually scared of everything. Yesterday we went to the park and saw a tiny little garden snake. Just a baby one! I wanted to touch it, but Leo screamed, "No way! Don't touch it, Sammy! It’s venomous!" Oh man, he was shaking like a leaf. I picked it up anyway because I’m brave. It felt cool and smooth. "Put it down!" he yelled. We’re never going on an adventure together again if he can't handle a worm with eyes. Wow, what a baby.

My dad told me a cool story about a brave **knight** who lived on a tiny **island**. The knight **thought** there was a dragon hiding in a dark cave. He walked **straight** into the cave with his shiny sword, but he didn't find any monsters at all. Instead, he **caught** a little lost puppy! The puppy was scared, so the knight carried him all the way home **through** the forest. I hope I can be brave like him one day.

My big sister acted like a brave knight in our backyard. She wore a shiny metal pot on her head. "We must go straight to the castle!" she yelled. I followed her past the swings. She said the sand pit was a lonely island surrounded by sharks. I thought she was being silly, but then she threw a ball at me. I caught it just in time! "That was close," I said. We played until mom called us for dinner because we had played enough.

Yesterday I played Minecraft with my friend Sam. We built a huge castle made of stone and glass. It was so cool! Then Sam said, "Let's play Roblox now." We played a game where we had to run away from a big monster. It was scary but funny. After that, my mom said, "Time for dinner!" but I wanted to watch Pokemon. I love Pikachu because he is yellow and strong. I hope I can play Fortnite tomorrow if I finish my homework fast.

My brother Toby thinks he’s so fast, but he’s not. Yesterday we raced to the big oak tree in the park. Ready, set, go! I took off like a rocket. My sneakers were pounding on the grass. Thump, thump, thump. I looked back and Toby was way behind me. No way! He actually tripped over his own feet. Oh man! It was kind of funny, but I stopped to help him up. He wasn't hurt, just mad. We’re going to race again tomorrow, and I bet I’ll win again. Easy peasy.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early because the sun was bright. For breakfast, I ate toast with jam and drank some milk. Then, I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a red ball. I ran very fast and got hot. We saw a cute dog that barked at us. After that, we went home for lunch. I had a cheese sandwich. I am tired now so I will go to sleep soon. It was fun.

I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw the box on my bed. Wow! It was huge and wrapped in shiny blue paper. I shook it, but it didn't make a sound. What if it's empty? No way! Mom promised she'd get me the new robot dog. I ripped the paper off as fast as I could. Oh man! It wasn't a robot dog at all. It was just a boring old coat. "We're going hiking tomorrow," Mom yelled from the kitchen. I don't want to hike. I just want a robot.

I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were playing tag near the big slide, and suddenly Tommy found a giant frog. Wow! It was huge and green and looked super slimy. No way! Everyone started screaming and running, but I wanted to touch it. It’s not every day you see a monster frog. Oh man! But then Mrs. Baker came over and told us to leave it alone. We’re going to look for it again tomorrow, but don't tell the teacher. It's going to be our secret pet.

He thought he could jump over it, but he fell right in! The water was very cold. Luckily, he swam to a tiny island in the middle. He caught a big fish for dinner and waited for a boat to come by. It was scary, but he was brave enough to stay calm until help came.

I can’t believe what happened at recess today! We were playing tag near the big slide, and suddenly Tommy yelled, "Look out!" A huge squirrel jumped right over my head. Whoa! It landed on the monkey bars and just stared at us. "No way!" said Sarah. "It wants to play too!" We tried to get closer, but it zoomed up a tree. It’s super fast. We’re going to bring some peanuts tomorrow to see if it comes back. Oh man, I hope it does! Best recess ever.

I couldn't believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. No way! My dog, Buster, was standing right on top of the table. Actually standing! He had his nose deep inside the birthday cake my mom just baked. Oh man! It was a total mess. Chocolate frosting everywhere. On his paws. On his ears. Even on the floor. "Buster, get down!" I yelled, but he didn't listen. He just wagged his tail like it was the best day ever. We're definitely going to need a new cake before the party starts. What a disaster!

I couldn't believe my eyes. Wow! There was a giant frog in the middle of the kitchen floor, and it was wearing my dad’s favorite tie. No way! I yelled for my sister, "Sarah, come look at this!" She ran in and stopped. "Oh man," she whispered. "We're in so much trouble if Mom sees." The frog just blinked at us. It didn't move. Suddenly, it hopped right onto the table. Splat! "Don't let it touch the pizza!" I shouted. We chased it around the chairs, but it was too fast. What a mess.

I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were playing tag near the big slide, and suddenly Tommy found a frog. A real frog! It was bright green and super slimy. Oh man! I couldn't believe it when I saw the huge box in the kitchen. Wow! It was taller than me. Mom said we're not allowed to open it until Dad gets home, but it's so hard to wait. I poked it a little bit. Nothing happened. Then I heard a weird noise inside. Scratch, scratch. No way! Is it a puppy? I hope so. "Please hurry up, Dad!" I yelled at the door. Oh man, waiting is the worst. I bet it's the best present ever. Just ten more minutes!

One day a brave knight went to a scary island to find a dragon. He walked straight into a big dark cave. "Come out!" he yelled really loud. Suddenly, he caught a cold because it was so wet in there. He sneezed so hard he fell over! He thought the dragon would be mean, but the dragon just handed him a tissue. "That is enough sneaking around," said the dragon. "Do you want to play tag instead?" So they played all day long.
